read.thesis: Supply-constrained: FY28 revenue guided ~70% growth with supply, not demand, the binding limit, while Q4 gross margin resets to 71–72% on memory costs and DSO rises to 60 days.

utilisation.quote: NVIDIA compute is fully utilized across every cloud we serve

triggers.label: Q4 gross margin bottoms at 71–72%
triggers.quote: We expect margins to bottom in Q4 in the 71% to 72% range before settling at 72% to 73% in fiscal year '28
triggers.highlight: margins to bottom in Q4 in the 71% to 72% range

triggers.label: DSO up to 60 days
triggers.quote: Days of sales outstanding increased to 60 days, reflecting extended payment terms for large purchases by certain investment-grade customers
triggers.highlight: Days of sales outstanding increased to 60 days

triggers.label: Supply bottleneck through FY28
triggers.quote: we expect supply to remain a bottleneck, at least through the end of fiscal year '28

triggers.label: FY28 revenue growth ~70%
triggers.quote: our preliminary expectation is for fiscal year '28 revenue to grow approximately 70% year-over-year
triggers.highlight: fiscal year '28 revenue to grow approximately 70%

triggers.label: Vendor financing and guarantees to AI labs
triggers.quote: For another frontier AI lab, we will provide selective credit enhancement for nearly 2 gigawatts of compute
triggers.highlight: selective credit enhancement for nearly 2 gigawatts

guidance.quote: Total revenue is expected to be $108 billion, plus or minus 2%.
we expect to grow revenue by approximately 70% in fiscal 2028
we expect GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins to be 74% plus or minus 50 basis points
We expect margins to bottom in Q4 in the 71% to 72% range
GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $9.2 billion and $9.0 billion, respectively.
For the full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low 50s
we continue to expect GAAP and non-GAAP taxes to be between 16% and 18%
our preliminary expectation is for CPU revenue to more than double in fiscal '28

red_flags.label: Circular financing / vendor credit support to AI labs
red_flags.quote: we will provide selective credit enhancement for nearly 2 gigawatts of compute

red_flags.label: Receivables stretched: DSO up to 60 days
red_flags.quote: Days of sales outstanding increased to 60 days, reflecting extended payment terms

red_flags.label: Inventory build ahead of launch
red_flags.quote: inventory increased to $32 billion as we prepared for the Vera Rubin launch

evasions.topic: Unconstrained demand size and growth bridge
evasions.quote: The unconstrained would be a lot higher. It's -- we grew 100% year-over-year this year.
There's something funny I could say, but I'm going to just not.
